text:
Before: a ham and cheese sub, with half a sub on each of two plates. The sub was a whole roll cut in half, roughly 350 g and 700 kcal. There was also a grilled ham and cheese sandwich (~200 g, 450 kcal), 3 pieces of sushi (~90 g, 150 kcal), a fruit bowl (~150 g, 70 kcal), orange juice (~200 g, 90 kcal), water, and wasabi.

After: one half of the sub is left, mostly intact, with some lettuce fallen off. The grilled sandwich is gone, the sushi is gone, the fruit is eaten, and the juice is gone (the second glass is probably water).

Eaten: half the sub is about 175 g and 350 kcal, plus the grilled sandwich (200 g, 450 kcal), sushi (90 g, 150 kcal), fruit (140 g, 65 kcal) and juice (200 g, 90 kcal).

Total kcal ≈ 350 + 450 + 150 + 65 + 90 = 1105.
Total mass ≈ 175 + 200 + 90 + 140 + 200 = 805 g.

{"kcal": 1100, "mass_g": 800}
